prompt: Artur says weekday mornings have (few) queues on the hill tram.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (queues) для значения «меньше всего» используется превосходная степень the fewest.

prompt: Bring a light jacket to our outdoor cinema — it is (windy) spot in Agadir.
explanation_ru: В рамке с предлогом места in Agadir требуется превосходная степень с артиклем the; у прилагательного windy конечная y меняется на i перед -est (the windiest).

prompt: Ting thinks the corner pharmacy in Tainan is ___ in her whole city.
options: one of the most helpful shop
one of the most helpful shops
explanation_ru: После конструкции one of the + превосходная степень существительное всегда стоит во множественном числе (shops), а артикль the обязателен.

prompt: Why does Manolis think sunrise is (least / crowded) hour to walk the old fort walls in Rethymno?
explanation_ru: Для значения «наименее многолюдный» используется превосходная степень с артиклем the и словом least: the least crowded.

prompt: We stayed at a hill family hotel in Taormina after reading Eva's review. The cook packed warm nut biscuits — easily (good) trail snack I (ever / taste). We didn't choose a big resort, because small inns feel much friendlier. In fact, the hosts treated us (kindly) of all the hotels we visited in Sicily.
explanation_ru: После превосходной степени (the best) для личного опыта используется Present Perfect с ever (have ever tasted). Наречие kindly образует превосходную степень через (the) most kindly.

prompt: Kaloyan says the seaside hotel in Sozopol is (one / reliable / employer) on the whole coast.

blanks.answer: one of the most reliable employers
accepted_answers: one of the most reliable employers

explanation_ru: Конструкция one of the + превосходная степень требует многосложной формы most reliable и множественного числа существительного (employers).

prompt: Palesa called the Knysna woodland walk one of the best trail here.
answer: Palesa called the Knysna woodland walk one of the best trails here.
accepted_answers: Palesa called the Knysna woodland walk one of the best trails here.
explanation_ru: После one of the + превосходная степень существительное обязательно ставится во множественном числе: one of the best trails.

prompt: Even though Ruby's favourite jazz basement in Folkestone is (second / small) music venue in town, its thick curtains make brass bands sound (smoothly) of all.
explanation_ru: Порядковое числительное перед превосходной степенью строится по модели the second smallest. Во втором пропуске наречие smoothly принимает форму превосходной степени (the) most smoothly.

prompt: On freezing boat decks near Harstad, Torstein says wax pencils smudge ___ of all writing tools.
explanation_ru: Превосходная степень от little — the least (меньше всего). Типичная ошибка — употреблять сравнительную форму the less вместо the least.

prompt: This folding saw is (sharp) tool I (ever / buy) in Tarragona.
explanation_ru: С превосходной степенью (the sharpest) для описания жизненного опыта используется Present Perfect со словом ever (have ever bought).

prompt: Have you seen Fabrizio's review of those light cycling gloves from the Savona club? I bought a pair for bumpy hill rides, and they are easily (comfortable) gloves in my drawer. They weigh (little) of all my winter gear, so I don't even feel them in my pocket. My hands used to ache on climbs, yet I finished Sunday's ride (fast) in my whole group.
explanation_ru: Усилитель easily сочетается с превосходной степенью the most comfortable; глагол weigh требует формы the least (меньше всего), а наречие fast — (the) fastest.

prompt: Lisbeth's club notice in Solothurn warns that sticking passwords around your screen is (bad) habit of all, while one notebook causes (little / trouble).
explanation_ru: Прилагательное bad имеет неправильную превосходную степень the worst, а с неисчисляемым существительным trouble используется форма the least trouble.

prompt: Wojtek says the replacement bus is ___ way to cross the river.
explanation_ru: Односложное прилагательное slow образует превосходную степень с артиклем the и суффиксом -est (the slowest), а не с помощью most.

prompt: Before booking his overnight journey north from Chiclayo, Hernan compared five different coach companies online. He picked the blue company because it recorded (few / delay) of all five lines. Although it was only (third / cheap) ticket at the counter, it didn't stop at noisy roadside cafes at 3 a.m. In his review, Hernan praised its drivers for steering (carefully) through the dark mountain bends.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным используется the fewest + множественное число (delays); порядковое числительное с превосходной степенью даёт the third cheapest; наречие carefully образует (the) most carefully.

prompt: Need a calm desk? Bethan recommends the glass room, (quiet) spot in college.
explanation_ru: В контексте выбора лучшего места в колледже (in college) нужна превосходная степень the quietest (допустимо также the most quiet).

prompt: Kirra has never found a cooler coastal path than this shady trail in Freycinet. → This shady trail in Freycinet is the coolest …
answer: This shady trail in Freycinet is the coolest coastal path Kirra has ever found.
accepted_answers: This shady trail in Freycinet is the coolest coastal path Kirra has ever found.
This shady trail in Freycinet is the coolest coastal path that Kirra has ever found.
explanation_ru: Отрицание never + сравнительная степень перестраивается в превосходную степень с Present Perfect и ever: the coolest coastal path (that) Kirra has ever found.

prompt: Joana's seaside office bought wireless keyboards that type (softly) of all the models they tested.
explanation_ru: Наречие softly описывает действие type и в сравнении со всеми моделями (of all) стоит в превосходной степени (the) most softly.

prompt: Dulce wrote that these silent desk fans are by far the most useful office items she has ever ordered.
answer: Dulce wrote that these silent desk fans are by far the most useful office items she has ever ordered.
accepted_answers: Dulce wrote that these silent desk fans are by far the most useful office items she has ever ordered.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: усилитель by far верно стоит перед превосходной степенью the most useful, а конструкция she has ever ordered правильно оформлена в Present Perfect.

prompt: Do not install that flashy new phone update if you own an older handset. At my repair shop in Hyderabad, Nikhil and I agree it is (bad) software release we (see) in years. Simple alarm clocks freeze overnight, and older screens respond (slowly) of all the devices on our bench. Even (patient) customer in my queue lost his temper when his morning alarm failed.
explanation_ru: Исключение bad даёт the worst и сочетается с Present Perfect (have seen); наречие slowly и прилагательное patient образуют превосходную степень с помощью most.

prompt: Hiding news apps in a back folder was (one / effective / change) I made during my exams in Gdynia.

blanks.answer: one of the most effective changes
accepted_answers: one of the most effective changes

explanation_ru: После one of the + превосходная степень (the most effective) существительное ставится во множественном числе: changes.

prompt: Mauricio tested four bus-tracking apps at a stop in Quito. The free local app cost nothing and showed arrival times more accurately than every paid app on his phone.
options: The free local app was the most expensive option, yet it arrived on time.
The free local app was the least accurate of the four apps Mauricio tried.
The free local app was the most reliable of all four apps, and it did not cost a cent.
The free local app was one of the most reliable app Mauricio has ever tried.
explanation_ru: Третий вариант точно передаёт ситуацию и правильно использует превосходную степень с of all four apps. В последнем варианте допущена ошибка — единственное число app после one of the.

prompt: Leo's trail board above Annecy warns visitors that the high ridge faces (strong) winds in the whole area, making late afternoon (least / safe) hour to climb.
explanation_ru: В сравнении по всему району (in the whole area) используется the strongest, а для обозначения наименее безопасного времени — the least safe.

prompt: "Should we study inside the warm glass room or outside on the terrace?" Lennart asked Merle. "Inside is (warm) spot in our whole college!" Merle smiled. Suddenly, a friendly animal walked past their chairs. "Well, he moves (slowly) of all our friends, so he won't bother us," Lennart laughed.
explanation_ru: Односложное прилагательное warm в рамке с in our whole college принимает форму the warmest, а наречие slowly — (the) most slowly.

prompt: In Aino's snowy Finnish school, labelling woollen gloves clearly is ___ way to avoid home-time tears.
explanation_ru: Усилитель easily ставится перед артиклем the и превосходной степенью (easily the best). Варианты easy, a best и порядок слов the easily best неверны.

prompt: Don't bring soup at noon — it's (busy) hour in my student hall.
explanation_ru: С предлогом места in my student hall нужна превосходная степень с артиклем the; конечная y в busy меняется на i перед -est (the busiest).

prompt: At the Debrecen campus book fair, Bence picked up seven used pocket maps from a wooden table. He couldn't carry a heavy book, so he searched for (slim) edition in the whole pile. The green map was (second / light) of the seven, and it slipped neatly beside his lunch bag. Even better, its folded map opened (easily) of all seven books, without tearing.
explanation_ru: В односложном slim перед -est удваивается согласная (the slimmest); порядковое числительное образует the second lightest; наречие easily требует (the) most easily.

prompt: Ignacio's study guide explains that reading short articles aloud is by far the most effective habit of the whole language school.
answer: Ignacio's study guide explains that reading short articles aloud is by far the most effective habit in the whole language school.
accepted_answers: Ignacio's study guide explains that reading short articles aloud is by far the most effective habit in the whole language school.
explanation_ru: После превосходной степени перед названием места или учреждения (the whole language school) используется предлог in, а не of.

prompt: Could this rainy exam morning be (stressful) shift we have ever had in Hailey's shop?
explanation_ru: Конструкция с Present Perfect и ever (we have ever had) требует превосходной степени с артиклем the: the most stressful.

prompt: Matthias complained that no other machine in our Regensburg office is noisier than the new kitchen fridge. → Matthias complained that the new kitchen fridge is …
answer: Matthias complained that the new kitchen fridge is the noisiest machine in our Regensburg office.
accepted_answers: Matthias complained that the new kitchen fridge is the noisiest machine in our Regensburg office.
Matthias complained that the new kitchen fridge is the noisiest of all the machines in our Regensburg office.
Matthias complained that the new kitchen fridge is the noisiest one in our Regensburg office.
explanation_ru: Отрицание no other ... is noisier than перестраивается в превосходную степень с предлогом места in: the noisiest machine in our Regensburg office.

prompt: "Excuse me, why are you weighing my slim guitar bag while two huge suitcases went straight aboard?" Keiran asked at Stansted. "It is easily (slim) bag in this entire boarding queue," he insisted, pointing at the scale. The gate clerk sighed, saying this busy Friday evening was (third / strict) weight check of the month. In the end, Keiran passed (quickly) of all the musicians on the flight, because his case weighed almost nothing.
explanation_ru: Усилитель easily сочетается с the slimmest (с удвоением m), порядковое числительное образует the third strictest, а наречие quickly — превосходную степень (the) most quickly.

prompt: Hampus tested five desk stools in Norrkoping and chose (soft) one.
explanation_ru: При выборе одного предмета из пяти нужна превосходная степень односложного прилагательного soft с артиклем the: the softest.

prompt: Six local bakery and cafe job adverts lay spread across Kenneth's desk at the Paisley job club. The riverside bakery didn't pay (well), yet its early morning bus route suited the teenage applicant perfectly. The station cafe sat (far) from her flat, so she crossed it off straight away. Together, they agreed the corner bread shop had (reasonable) hours for someone still finishing school.
explanation_ru: Наречия-исключения well и far в превосходной степени дают the best и (the) furthest / farthest, а многосложное прилагательное reasonable — the most reasonable.

prompt: Gerlinde reminds hotel kitchen trainees in St. Polten that keeping knives and herbs neatly lined up helps them work ___ during lunch.
explanation_ru: Глагол work описывается наречием smoothly, превосходная степень которого образуется с помощью the most (the most smoothly). Остальные варианты содержат ошибки формы или части речи.

prompt: Fumiko lifted seven clay mugs off a wooden shelf in Okayama. The blue mug felt lighter than all the other six.
options: The blue mug was the lightest of the seven mugs.
The blue mug was the lighter of the seven mugs.
The blue mug was the heaviest of the seven mugs.
The blue mug was the most light of the seven mugs.
explanation_ru: При сравнении семи предметов нужна превосходная степень односложного прилагательного light — the lightest. Неверно ставить сравнительную степень the lighter или форму the most light.

prompt: Sunniva emailed the online shop immediately because this plastic-smelling kettle is the worse product she has ever bought.
answer: Sunniva emailed the online shop immediately because this plastic-smelling kettle is the worst product she has ever bought.
accepted_answers: Sunniva emailed the online shop immediately because this plastic-smelling kettle is the worst product she has ever bought.
explanation_ru: Прилагательное-исключение bad имеет сравнительную степень worse и превосходную the worst; в конструкции с the ... she has ever bought нужна именно the worst.
